question_or_proposition: Whether, for Outfall 001, the numeric discharge limits and monitoring requirements in Section A.1 attach only to discharges of storm runoffs from storage and production areas, once-through cooling water, cleaning water, and/or Artesian well water, or to any discharge from Outfall 001 while the authorization period is in effect.
required_context: The Outfall 001 authorization paragraph and its associated limits and monitoring table on the same page
Permit language linking Section A.1 requirements to actual discharge events or discharge types
Evidence of which discharge types occurred at Outfall 001 during Federal FY2025
source_locator: Page: 3, Section: part_i, Outfalls 001 authorization paragraph
notes: The nominated passage authorizes specific discharge categories and immediately conditions the limits/monitoring table with 'Such discharges shall be limited and monitored as specified below.' Resolving whether applicability tracks those enumerated categories or the outfall generally would change limit comparisons, monitoring obligation determinations, and missing-evidence classifications for periods without clearly authorized discharge types.
